reason: Primary purpose is to provide a DSH persona/profile bundle that automatically loads OpenClaw-style workspace files into agent context (system prompt sections and runtime context), including recent daily notes and memory files. It is a local context/automation plugin for agent sessions, with optional env-based directory and note limits. Risks are limited to workspace file exposure/consumption in prompts; no external integrations are indicated.

capabilities: Reads OpenClaw persona and memory markdown files from the workspace and injects their contents into agent system prompt/runtime context.
Registers itself in DSH via a bundle patch and applies automatically per agent session when workspace matches.
Listens to file tool events to refresh cached context after successful reads/writes/edits inside the persona directory.

reasons.code: Reads local workspace files such as SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, TOOLS.md, MEMORY.md, HEARTBEAT.md, and memory/*.md and uses their content in prompts.
Applies to sessions automatically via DSH host-scoped Cordis plugin hook on agent creation, affecting all matching sessions.
No declared external service calls or network integration; behavior is limited to local filesystem reads and agent context injection.
Plugin metadata declares a DSH bundle via cordis.patch.yml and exports a runtime loader entrypoint.
